P.when('A', 'base-mixin', 'sbv-video', 'sbv-ad-unit', 'sbv-swv-components-lib').register(
    'sbv-video-single-mixin',
    function (A, BaseMixin, Video, AdUnit, SWVComponentsLib) {
        var STYLE_AUI_HIDE = 'aok-hidden';
        var SBV_ADBLOCK_DETECTED_CLASS = 'sbv-abd';

        var NO_DUPE_INLINE = 'NO_DUPE_INLINE';
        var NO_DUPE_BOTTOM_SINGLE = 'NO_DUPE_BOTTOM_SINGLE';
        var NO_DUPE_BOTTOM_MULTI = 'NO_DUPE_BOTTOM_MULTI';
        var DUPE_BOTTOM = 'DUPE_BOTTOM';

        return {
            dupeCheck: function (component, metricsManager) {
                var widgetGroupId = component.prop('widgetGroupId') || '';
                var pageNumber = component.prop('pageNumber') || '';
                var pageOneAdCount = 0;
                if (pageNumber === '1') {
                    if (widgetGroupId === 'loom-mobile-inline-slot' || widgetGroupId === 'loom-desktop-inline-slot') {
                        return NO_DUPE_INLINE;
                    } else if (
                        widgetGroupId === 'loom-mobile-bottom-slot' ||
                        widgetGroupId === 'loom-desktop-bottom-slot'
                    ) {
                        var sbvAds = document.getElementsByClassName('sbv-video-single-product');
                        // max 2 per page currently
                        var numOfSbvAds = sbvAds.length;
                        var prevAdId = '';
                        var prevCampaignId = '';
                        for (var i = 0; i < numOfSbvAds; i++) {
                            var dataProps = sbvAds[i].getAttribute('data-component-props');
                            var dataPropsParsed = JSON.parse(dataProps);
                            if (dataPropsParsed.pageNumber === '1') {
                                pageOneAdCount++;
                                if (prevAdId === '') {
                                    prevAdId = dataPropsParsed.advertiserId || '';
                                    prevCampaignId = dataPropsParsed.campaignId || '';
                                } else if (
                                    dataPropsParsed.advertiserId === prevAdId &&
                                    dataPropsParsed.campaignId === prevCampaignId
                                ) {
                                    return DUPE_BOTTOM;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (pageOneAdCount > 1) {
                    return NO_DUPE_BOTTOM_MULTI;
                }

                return NO_DUPE_BOTTOM_SINGLE;
            },

            init: function (
                attribution,
                $videoSingleContent,
                sbvContentElem,
                sbvSecondaryContentElem,
                component,
                SingleContent,
                SecondaryContent,
                clientExecutionMode
            ) {
                var $sbvVideo = $videoSingleContent.find('.sbv-video:first');
                var $sbvVideoElem = $sbvVideo.find('video:first').get(0);
                var $sbvProductTitle = $videoSingleContent.find('.faceout-product-title a h2').get(0);
                var builder = BaseMixin.setup(attribution, $videoSingleContent, component);
                var metricsManager = builder
                    .withVideoPreviewImageSrc(component.prop('videoPreviewImageSrc'))
                    .withContentHash(component.prop('contentHash') || '')
                    .withVideoSrc(component.prop('videoSrc'))
                    .withHasAudio(component.prop('hasAudio') === 'true')
                    .withStoreName(component.prop('storeName') || '')
                    .withStoreUrl(component.prop('storeUrl') || '')
                    .withStoreCta(component.prop('storeCta') || '')
                    .withVideoType(component.prop('videoType') || '')
                    .build();
                if (
                    ($videoSingleContent.hasClass(STYLE_AUI_HIDE) &&
                        $videoSingleContent.hasClass(SBV_ADBLOCK_DETECTED_CLASS)) ||
                    $videoSingleContent.css('display') == 'none'
                ) {
                    metricsManager.reportAdRenderSuppressed();
                } else {
                    metricsManager.reportAceVideoResponseReceivedWithDupeInfo(
                        this.dupeCheck(component, metricsManager),
                        clientExecutionMode
                    );

                    var adUnit;
                    var isVcpmEnabled = component.prop('isVcpmEnabled') === 'true';
                    if (isVcpmEnabled) {
                        adUnit = AdUnit.initialize(attribution, $videoSingleContent.get(0));
                        adUnit.attach();
                    }

                    var video = Video.initialize(
                        attribution,
                        $sbvVideo.get(0),
                        metricsManager,
                        component.prop('instrumentationPixelUrl'),
                        isVcpmEnabled,
                        adUnit
                    );

                    SingleContent.initialize(sbvContentElem, metricsManager, video);

                    if (SecondaryContent && sbvSecondaryContentElem) {
                        SecondaryContent.initialize(sbvSecondaryContentElem, metricsManager, video);
                    }

                    SWVComponentsLib.initializeDisclosure($videoSingleContent.get(0), {
                        onDisclosureRendered: function () {
                            metricsManager.reportDisclosureDisplayed();
                        },
                        onDisclosureOpened: function () {
                            metricsManager.reportDisclosureOpened();
                        },
                    });
                }
                this.updateAriaLabel($sbvVideoElem, $sbvProductTitle);
            },
            setup: function (
                attribution,
                $videoSingleContent,
                sbvContentElem,
                sbvSecondaryContentElem,
                component,
                SingleContent,
                SecondaryContent,
                clientExecutionMode
            ) {
                this.init(
                    attribution,
                    $videoSingleContent,
                    sbvContentElem,
                    sbvSecondaryContentElem,
                    component,
                    SingleContent,
                    SecondaryContent,
                    clientExecutionMode
                );
            },
            updateAriaLabel: function ($sbvVideo, $sbvProductTitle) {
                if (!$sbvVideo || !$sbvProductTitle) {
                    return;
                }
                var productTitle = $sbvProductTitle.getAttribute('aria-label');
                var videoAriaLabel = $sbvVideo.getAttribute('aria-label');
                if (productTitle) {
                    $sbvVideo.setAttribute('aria-label', videoAriaLabel + ' ' + productTitle);
                }
            },
        };
    }
);

P.when('A')
    .register('sbv-video-single-content-mixin', function(A) {
        return {
            loadAdFeedback: function(metricsManager, templateId, $sponsoredLabel, feedbackElement) {
                try {
                    if (feedbackElement) {
                        var TEMPLATE_ID = templateId;
                        var AD_FEEDBACK_URL = '/af/feedback-link';
                        var AD_PROGRAM_ID = 1010;
                        var AD_NETWORK = 'aax';
                        var AD_IMPRESSION_ID = '';
                        var CAMPAIGN_ID = A.$(feedbackElement).attr("data-cid");
                        var AD_ID = A.$(feedbackElement).attr("data-aid");
                        var PAGE_TYPE = 'Search';
                        var SLOT_NAME = A.$(feedbackElement).data("slotname");
                        var ENCODED_SEARCH_TERMS = A.$(feedbackElement).data("searchkeywords");
                        var KEYWORD_ENCODING_FAILED = A.$(feedbackElement).data("keywordEncodingFailed");
                        var SELECTION_SIGNALS = A.$(feedbackElement).data("selectionsignals");
                        var ADVERTISER_ID_NS = A.$(feedbackElement).data("advertiseridns");

                        if (KEYWORD_ENCODING_FAILED === 'true') {
                            metricsManager.reportAdFeedbackKeywordEncodingFailure();
                        }

                        SELECTION_SIGNALS = SELECTION_SIGNALS === '' ? null : SELECTION_SIGNALS;
                        ADVERTISER_ID_NS = ADVERTISER_ID_NS === '' ? null : ADVERTISER_ID_NS;

                        var feedbackRequestParamsJson = JSON.stringify({
                            adPlacementMetaData: {
                                adElementId: TEMPLATE_ID,
                                pageType: PAGE_TYPE,
                                slotName: SLOT_NAME,
                                pageUrl: '',
                                searchTerms: ENCODED_SEARCH_TERMS
                            },
                            adCreativeMetaData: {
                                adNetwork: AD_NETWORK,
                                adProgramId: AD_PROGRAM_ID,
                                adImpressionId: AD_IMPRESSION_ID,
                                adId: AD_ID,
                                adCreativeDetails: [
                                    {
                                        campaignId: CAMPAIGN_ID,
                                        advertiserIdNS: ADVERTISER_ID_NS,
                                        selectionSignals: SELECTION_SIGNALS
                                    }
                                ]
                            }
                        });

                        var feedbackRequestUrl = window.location.protocol
                            + '//'
                            + window.location.hostname
                            + AD_FEEDBACK_URL
                            + '?pl='
                            + encodeURIComponent(feedbackRequestParamsJson);

                        var feedbackFormRequest = new XMLHttpRequest();

                        feedbackFormRequest.onreadystatechange = function () {
                            if (feedbackFormRequest.readyState !== 4 || feedbackFormRequest.status !== 200) {
                                return;
                            }

                            var feedbackFormRequestAjaxResponse = feedbackFormRequest.responseText;
                            var feedbackFormRequestResponse = JSON.parse(feedbackFormRequestAjaxResponse);

                            if (feedbackFormRequestResponse && feedbackFormRequestResponse.status === 'ok') {
                                if (('html' in feedbackFormRequestResponse) && feedbackFormRequestResponse.html) {
                                    $sponsoredLabel.addClass('aok-hidden');
                                    feedbackElement.innerHTML = feedbackFormRequestResponse.html;
                                    A.$(feedbackElement).removeClass('aok-hidden');
                                    metricsManager.reportAdFeedbackLoadSucceeded(feedbackFormRequest.status);
                                }

                                if (('script' in feedbackFormRequestResponse) && feedbackFormRequestResponse.script) {
                                    var scriptWrapper = document.createElement('script');
                                    scriptWrapper.type = 'text/javascript';
                                    scriptWrapper.innerHTML = feedbackFormRequestResponse.script;
                                    feedbackElement.appendChild(scriptWrapper);
                                }

                                A.$(feedbackElement).find('a').click(function () {
                                    metricsManager.reportAdFeedbackPopoverOpened();
                                });

                            } else {
                                // Failed to Generated Sponsored Label with Feedback
                                metricsManager.reportAdFeedbackLoadFailed(feedbackFormRequest.status);
                            }
                        };

                        feedbackFormRequest.open('GET', feedbackRequestUrl, true);
                        feedbackFormRequest.send();
                    }
                }
                catch (error) {
                    var maxLength = 4000; // error_message = varchar(4000)
                    var trimmedErrorMessage = error.message.length > maxLength ?
                        error.message.substring(0, maxLength - 3) + "..." :
                        error.message;
                    metricsManager.reportAdFeedbackLoadFailedFromErr(trimmedErrorMessage);
                }
            }
        }
    });

P.when("A", "3p-promise").register("sbv-adblock-detector", function(A, Promise) {
    var ADBLOCK_DETECTION_URL = "https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js?_=1607460946161";
    var REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 2000;
    var options = {
        method: "HEAD",
        mode: "no-cors",
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'plain/text'
        }
    };

    return {
        timeoutWrapper: function(timeoutMs) {
            return new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
                var timer = setTimeout(function() {
                    clearTimeout(timer);
                    resolve();
                }, timeoutMs)
            });
        },
        fetchWrapper: function(requestUrl, requestOptions, timeoutMs) {
            var timeoutPromise = this.timeoutWrapper(timeoutMs);

            var fetchPromise = window.fetch(requestUrl, requestOptions);

            return Promise.race([
                fetchPromise,
                timeoutPromise
            ]);
        },
        init: function() {
            var $videoSingleProduct = A.$(".sbv-video-single-product");
            //This only will exist on desktop
            var $sbvCompliantAdBlockDetected = $videoSingleProduct.find(".sbv-compliant-abd");
            if ($sbvCompliantAdBlockDetected.length) {
                var adBlockDetectedPromise = this.fetchWrapper(ADBLOCK_DETECTION_URL, options, REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS);
                return new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
                    adBlockDetectedPromise
                        .then(function(result) {
                            //AdBlock was not detected. This means a request was made. Could either have been
                            //successful or timed out.
                            reject(result);
                        })
                        .catch(function(result) {
                            //AdBlock was detected. Only fails on network failure or
                            //if anything prevented the request from completing
                            //https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Fetch_API/Using_Fetch
                            resolve(result);
                        });
                });
            }
        }
    }
});

        return widgetGroupId === WidgetGroupId.INLINE_MOBILE || widgetGroupId === WidgetGroupId.INLINE_DESKTOP;
    }

    function isBottom(widgetGroupId) {
        return widgetGroupId === WidgetGroupId.BOTTOM_MOBILE || widgetGroupId === WidgetGroupId.BOTTOM_DESKTOP;
    }

    function isInlineMobileWidget(widgetGroupId) {
        return widgetGroupId === WidgetGroupId.INLINE_MOBILE;
    };
    
    function isBottomMobileWidget(widgetGroupId) {
        return widgetGroupId === WidgetGroupId.BOTTOM_MOBILE;
    };

    function isMobileNonSparklePage2PlusWidget(widgetGroupId, pageNumber) {
        return (isInlineMobileWidget(widgetGroupId) || isBottomMobileWidget(widgetGroupId)) && 
            parseInt('' + pageNumber) > 1;
    };

    function getAllUpperPlacementSbvAdsProps (widgetGroupId, pageNumber) {
        var isInlineAd = isInline(widgetGroupId);
        var isBottomAd = isBottom(widgetGroupId);

        return [].slice.call(A.$(".sb-video-creative"))
        .map(function (sbvAdElement) {
            return JSON.parse(sbvAdElement.getAttribute('data-component-props'));
        }).filter(function(sbvAdDataProps){
            var widgetGroupIdForAd = sbvAdDataProps.widgetGroupId;
            var pageNumberForAd = sbvAdDataProps.pageNumber;

            if(pageNumber === pageNumberForAd) {
                if(isInlineAd) {
                    return isTop(widgetGroupIdForAd);
                } else if(isBottomAd) {
                    return isTop(widgetGroupIdForAd) || isInline(widgetGroupIdForAd)
                }
            }

            return false;
        });
    }

    return {
        getAllUpperPlacementSbvAdsProps: getAllUpperPlacementSbvAdsProps,
        isTop: isTop,
        isInline: isInline,
        isBottom: isBottom,
        isInlineMobileWidget: isInlineMobileWidget,
        isBottomMobileWidget: isBottomMobileWidget,
        isMobileNonSparklePage2PlusWidget: isMobileNonSparklePage2PlusWidget
    };
});

P.register('sbv-retryable', function () {
    function Retryable (callback, numRetries, pollingIntervalMs, errorCallback) {
        var _callback = callback;
        var _errorCallback = errorCallback;
        var _numRetries = numRetries;
        var _intervalID = null;
        var _pollingIntervalMs = pollingIntervalMs;
        var self = this;

        this._init = function _init() {
            // Invoke the callback...
            _callback();

            // ...and set up a potential retry:
            this._intervalID = setInterval(callbackInternal, _pollingIntervalMs);
        }

        function callbackInternal() {
            // Invoke the callback...
            if (_numRetries > 0) {
                _numRetries--;
                _callback();
            } else {
                self.cancel();
                _errorCallback();
            }
        }

        this.cancel = function cancel () {
            clearInterval(this._intervalID);
        }

        this._init();
    }

    return Retryable;
});

        var mbvCarousel = this;

        var onCarouselPageChange = function(eventData) {
            var newPage = eventData.newValue - 1;

            //Pause current video
            var currVideo = mbvCarousel.mbvCarouselItemElements[mbvCarousel.currentPlayingIndex].video;
            currVideo.onFiftyPercentViewability(0, false);

            mbvCarousel.currentPlayingIndex = newPage;

                var mbvVideoElem = mbvCarouselItemElement.getElementsByClassName("sbv-video")[0];
                var video = Video.initialize(attribution, mbvVideoElem, metricsManager, instrumentationPixelUrl);

                var mbvProductElem = mbvCarouselItemElement.getElementsByClassName("sbv-product")[0];
                var singleProduct = SingleProduct.initialize(mbvProductElem, metricsManager, video);

                    product: singleProduct

        var sbVideoState = getState();
        sbVideoState[key] = value;

        updatePageState(sbVideoState);
    }

    function getItem(key) {
        return getState()[key];
    }

    function getState() {
        return A.state('sb-video-state') || {};
    }

        delete sbVideoState[key];
        updatePageState(sbVideoState);
    }

    function updatePageState(sbVideoState) {
        A.state('sb-video-state', sbVideoState);
    }

    return {
        addItem: addItem,
        getItem: getItem,
        getState: getState,
        removeItem: removeItem,

    };
